description: School meal menu (breakfast/lunch/dinner) for a day, this week, next week or this month, with calories, macronutrients and allergens per dish. Pass the user's allergies to flag dishes that contain them. No meals on weekends and school holidays.

allergies.description: Allergies to flag, in English or Korean, e.g. ['milk', 'peanut'] or ['우유', '땅콩']. 19 Korean standard allergens.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD (Korea time). Omit for today.

eduCode.description: Office of education code from search_schools, e.g. 'B10'

meal.description: Only this meal. Most schools serve lunch only.

range.description: Instead of one day: this week (Mon–Fri), next week, or this month

name: get_meals
title: School meal menu
